speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details, Mr. [Name]. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-Thrombotic Syndrome with chronic venous insufficiency and a venous stasis ulcer. Your history of DVT in this leg, combined with chronic swelling and a non-healing wound, strongly points to venous hypertension causing the ulcer. The family history also suggests a possible hereditary component to your vascular health, but the DVT is the primary driver of your current symptoms.
